question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation after a priming pulse
ideas.description: Induce a transient stimulus, then rapidly degrade FOS or JUN with an inducible degron (e.g., dTAG or auxin-inducible) at defined times after washout. Track chromatin accessibility (ATAC-seq), enhancer marks (H3K27ac), and expression of putative memory genes over days; persistence after AP-1 loss would support a self-sustaining memory, while rapid decay would argue AP-1 is only a transient readout.

ideas.title: Time-course of chromatin persistence at AP-1 sites with motif-mutant controls
ideas.description: After a single pulse with washout, profile CUT&RUN for AP-1 and ATAC-seq/H3K4me1/H3K27ac at multiple timepoints out to weeks. Compare enhancers with intact AP-1 motifs against CRISPR-edited motif-mutant versions of the same elements to test whether AP-1 binding is required for the persistent chromatin state.

ideas.title: Priming-and-reinduction assay for transcriptional memory
ideas.description: Prime cells with a sub-threshold stimulus, wait variable intervals, then re-stimulate and measure the speed and magnitude of FOS/JUN induction and downstream target expression relative to naive cells. Repeat in cells carrying AP-1 binding-site mutations or lacking a chromatin-remodeling cofactor to see whether faster or stronger reinduction depends on AP-1 itself.

ideas.title: Live reporter lineage tracing of AP-1 activity across divisions
ideas.description: Use a destabilized-fluorescent AP-1 target reporter combined with a stable lineage barcode or histone-label to follow individual cells through several divisions after stimulation. Sort subpopulations by heritable reporter state and compare their chromatin landscapes and response to a second stimulus, testing whether AP-1 activity states are inherited through cell division.

ideas.title: Stabilized AP-1 variant sufficiency and ensemble reactivation test
ideas.description: Express a degradation-resistant or long-lived AP-1 isoform (e.g., a ΔFosB-like stabilized FOS) and test whether it extends the duration of induced chromatin and behavioral or functional changes beyond wild-type lifetimes. Pair this with activity-dependent ensemble tagging and optogenetic or chemogenetic reactivation to determine whether reactivating the tagged, AP-1-positive population is necessary and sufficient to recall the stored state.
